interpretation_limits: Shell untrimmed cambered reference deliberately retained; perturbation operator does not represent a solved loaded equilibrium.
20mm guard is an exploratory stop, not a flight or structural limit.
Ten modes, no actual carbon/spars/joint/control/test calibration; zero assumed damping.
Shell coarse/finer cases change mesh and dt together, not an isolated convergence study.
